changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE obra_social_plan_prestacion ADD CONSTRAINT ck_obra_social_plan_prestacion_modalidad CHECK (modalidad_cobertura IN ('TOTAL','CARGO_FIJO','PORCENTUAL'));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_obra_social_plan_prestacion_plan_prestacion ON obra_social_plan_prestacion (plan_id, prestacion_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE obra_social_plan_prestacion DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_obra_social_plan_prestacion_modalidad;
ALTER TABLE obra_social_plan_prestacion DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_obra_social_plan_prestacion_coherencia;
